title: BNCI 2015-001 Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class motor imagery (sustained right-hand palmar grip versus both-feet plantar extension) across two sessions, with 200 trials per session. Data were recorded from 13 sensorimotor channels at 512 Hz with visual cursor feedback, in support of an autocalibrating, recurrently adapting online ERD-based brain-computer interface. The dataset is distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with g.tec active electrodes (g.GAMMAsys cap) from 13 channels over sensorimotor areas in a 10-20 layout at 512 Hz, with a 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filter, plus a GSR auxiliary channel. Each trial had a 3 s reference period followed by a cue (1.25 s) and 4 s of kinesthetic motor imagery with visual feedback. Original analyses used logarithmic bandpower and CSP features with LDA classification.

funding_references.funder_name: FP7 Framework EU Research Project BrainAble
